facecam.name: Auto (per stream)
facecam.desc: The tool checks this stream's own frames and picks the freest corner — avoids the HUD and the streamer's own facecam. Default.

facecam.name: Top-right corner
facecam.desc: PeakCut-like corner — the streamer's face, bigger than PeakCut (40% of width).

facecam.name: Top-left corner
facecam.desc: Mirror of top-right — for streams whose top-right has a HUD or logo.

facecam.name: Mid-right
facecam.desc: Right side, vertically centred — below the top HUD, above the caption band.

facecam.name: Mid-left
facecam.desc: Left side, vertically centred — same as mid-right, other side.

facecam.name: Bottom-left
facecam.desc: Bottom-left corner, above the platform UI strip — captions move up to clear it.

facecam.name: Bottom-right
facecam.desc: Bottom-right corner, above the platform UI strip — captions move up to clear it.

facecam.name: Top band (full width)
facecam.desc: Clipie-style: the facecam stretches across the whole top ~33% as a band, gameplay fills below it.

facecam.name: Off (no facecam)
facecam.desc: No facecam overlay at all — just the game, full frame.

caption.name: Auto (first free line)
caption.desc: The tool checks the facecam + HUD and picks the first free line: bottom, then higher. Default.

caption.name: Bottom band (y~950-1000)
caption.desc: Text at y~950-1000 — below the action centre, above the platforms' own UI. sohaib's verdict, the default.

caption.name: Seam (below the facecam band)
caption.desc: Text just below the top-band facecam (Clipie-style seam). Best with the top-band facecam.

caption.name: Top
caption.desc: Text at the very top of the frame — for when the bottom is busy (HUD, subtitles in the game).
